targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-640 is a measurement-success diagnostic (claim_ids=[]); no claim weighting. Discriminator-grid read (638a Sections 7-8): cue-to-action AUTHORITY missing (grid row 1) -- cue fires 1557x (713/296/548) but moves z_goal ~0.4% (cue_zgoal_pull_norm ~0.002 vs ||z_goal||~0.45) and post-cue approach rate == cue-independent background (0.089 vs 0.090; 0.057 vs 0.054; 0.101 vs 0.117), with ARM_CUE_ON contact == ARM_OFF contact on every seed. The 638a DISPLACEMENT hypothesis is REFUTED (||z_goal|| at fire equal-or-higher than the ARM_OFF attractor norm). The interoceptive reading is not the proximate cause (seed 42: 713 fires, z_goal preserved, zero approach lift). Root: cue_recall_gain (0.2) x weak token value (~0.2) -> sub-threshold z_goal pull. n_cue_action_bias_present=0 is the SD-016 cue_action_proj channel (EXP-0155/EXQ-449 ungrounded) which the SD-057 cue does not use -- expected-absent, not the finding.
